# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome lad with broad shoulders, clear straightforward eyes, and curly brown hair. He has roguish hazel eyes and a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile. Even as he matures beyond a schoolboy, he retains a fine, frank face.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is popular, frank, and straightforward, possessing a teasing sense of humor. He is broad-minded, fair, and willing to admit his mistakes, showing persistence and dedication both in his academic rivalries and his personal devotions. Conscious of high ideals, he guards his words and deeds carefully to remain worthy of true friendship.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## Traits

- Frank-faced and straightforward  <sub>[v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>
- Teasing and playful  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P53](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0053)</sub>

- Popular  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academic excellence  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep himself worthy of Anne's friendship and eventually win her love  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)</sub>
- To excel in his studies and keep head of his class  <sub>[v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024)</sub>

## History

After living in Alberta for three years while his father recovered from illness, Gilbert returned to Avonlea and resumed his schooling. On his first day back, he teased Anne Shirley by pulling her red hair braid and calling her 'Carrots', sparking an intense academic rivalry that lasted for years. Despite his repeated attempts to apologize and make amends, Anne stubbornly refused to speak to him for a long time, though they eventually established a close friendship. Gilbert continued his education at Queen's Academy and later taught school while encouraging civic efforts in Avonlea. He pursued higher education at college, maintaining a steadfast devotion to Anne through all their years together. During one summer break, Gilbert suffered a severe, near-fatal case of typhoid fever, which ultimately made Anne realize the depth of her love for him.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c19 P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016)_
